Name: Charcoal Generating Equipment and Charcoal Grill
Author: tikamin557
Description:
Charcoal generating equipment learns recipes when the foraging level reaches 4.
When 10 pieces of wood and 1 piece of coal are added, charcoal is produced.

Charcoal generating deluxe equipment learns recipes when the foraging level reaches 6.
Less time and materials than the standard version. When 50 pieces of wood and 5 piece of coal are added, 10 charcoal is produced.

Charcoal grill learns recipes when the combat level reaches 4.
Consume charcoal to process foodstuffs.
(Currently only processing bug meat)

Anything that can be processed in the grill may be added later.

Russian translation. Colleagues: mukers
